conditions.notes: Open-circuit back-EMF fundamental at rated speed nn = 99.4 rpm, expressed from the datasheet voltage constant Ku = 18.8 V line-line rms per mech rad/s (terminal-to-terminal): E_ph_pk = sqrt(2)/sqrt(3) * Ku * omega_mech.

provenance_note: Unit conversion of the datasheet constant, NOT an independent measurement: the motor TOML psi_f = 0.465156 Wb is DERIVED from this same Ku (psi_f = sqrt(2)*Ku/(sqrt(3)*n_p)), so backemf_fundamental here equals psi_f*n_p*omega by construction. derived_params arms the calibration circularity guard (REQ-0819): fitting psi_f (or interderivable B_rem) against this dataset is an echo, not a calibration, and is refused.
